verdict.rationale: A customer data platform could plausibly ship MCP-client support, for example so its AI features could call external tools. The question therefore applies, but no evidence shows Segment can connect to or consume MCP servers. The 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor' links on the docs pages are a documentation-sharing convenience, not an MCP-client capability. Functions and the Public API are developer building blocks, not this capability.
